name: Charge Bearer 1 Code
definition: Specifies which party(ies) will pay charges due for processing of the payment transaction.

OUR.name: Borne By Debtor
OUR.definition: All transaction charges are to be borne by the debtor.

BEN.name: Borne By Creditor
BEN.definition: All transaction charges are to be borne by the creditor.

SHA.name: Shared
SHA.definition: Under the credit transfer scenario, transaction charges on the sender's side are to be borne by the debtor; transaction charges on the receiver's side are to be borne by the creditor.
